structural_change: h15a (Q-TTH15 10-17): h15 RTL + MY macros, NO home blockages (h15 gate: E band routability overflow 46% tiles pushed the controller into the W strip anyway, reg->reg -642). h15 (Q-TTH15 2026-10-17, coordinator-approved structure) after the h14d --cts gate (WARN, never submitted): TT placement-RC reg->macro -128.7 (one pw_d2 flop -> 16 wd_in pins on both edges of both macros, 4 repeaters 484 ps), reg->reg -116.8 (pend2 -> 1,024-load fq enable tree), o_cnt ripple -110.4, me_tiles dsel+add -103.6, sched_q -86.9/-115.5, am_wins -107.5, recovery -47.8; root cause = std cells smeared at 17.5% density as a ring around a centred macro stack whose read pins (W) and write pins (W+E) face opposite edges. h15: (1) both macros MIRRORED (MY) at the same lattice origins, so the read/clk edge (rd_out, r_addr, clk, w_addr, wd_in[265:0]) faces the E band; (2) the controller is packed into the E band + SE S band (home, ~14.1k um2) by 15% partial placement blockages on the N band and the SW S band; W strip = pin flops + the macros' W-edge write copies; (3) RTL H15=1 (ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_static_hr): PWCP write-pin copies per macro x pin edge, FQWE registered one-hot FIFO write enables + prog_q capture-enable slice copies, OINC, DTIL, SLATE, AMWC, RRH (12 reset copies) -- all exact, 0 edges, ~+560 flops; regroup bench m0 vs the original head + negative controls; (4) clocks: ck_head S x 194-198 under the home register mass; raw SRAM entries ck_pm0 S x 224-228 and ck_pm1 E y 120-124 (die-plan slots granted, HANDOFF). Outline 259.2 x 222.48 unchanged. h14d (Q-TTH14 2026-10-17) after the h14/h14c --cts gates (ot-agidock128 10:25): h14 TT reg->reg -110.5 (h14c -182.5), clock 8,960 sinks ins 488.6 / spread 232.7 (h13 413/52). po_me_i_obase class GONE; its siblings mbase/ojs/ots remain (-62/-57/-55) and the new worst class is u_ctrl_me.st -> g_hfc run_c / fq[*][*] (316 endpoints, -94): 3 logic gates + 5-8 repeaters of 60-140 ps each (wire) plus 123 ps launch/capture skew (372 vs 249). Cause = the h14 outline: 63.1k um2 (+46% vs h13) for ~5.8k um2 of std cells (std region ~16% full), a 24-um N sliver above the stack, i.e. a ring around the macros. h14d keeps the h14 RTL (DSEL=1, exact, 0 edges) and fixes the floorplan: 259.2x222.48 (1.17:1, 57.7k um2, -9%), SRAM stack on the 43.2 lattice (43.2,43.2)/(43.2,121.008) abutted_stack as h14, N channel 21.7 um (tool minimum 20 on a pin-free face), ONE S band (255x35.6 um) + W leg 35.6 (493 W pins) + E leg 37.2 (was 15.5; 1,088 E pins, <=5.0/um); ck_head at the S band centre. Regional roots NOT used: h6/t6 split ck_me_sched cost sched<->core -429 ps (die-skew reserve on every cross-root hop); one root on a compact outline instead. | h14 (Q-TTH14 2026-10-17) after the h13 REJECT on current main: (1) path class of the h13 gate worst (po_me_i_obase -64.8): NOT memory inference / fanout / an RTL depth increase -- the h13 synthesized netlist is identical before and after the main merge (45,451 cells, 32,466.2046 um2; BAND=1 keeps BITS_PER_BAND 3, matvec_part not in this tile); it is placement wire: dyn[2] -> ~400 ps of repeaters across the ring -> 8:1 dyn select -> KS add. RTL DSEL=1: the DPRE adds' DYN operand is registered per head word (dq0/dq1) on the hq/hq1 fill edge by a kept fill slice (dyn fixed in S_RUN): exact, 0 edges (m0 REGROUP_PASS 65120; OT_DSEL_MUT REGROUP_FAIL 390702). (2) floorplan: SRAM stack on the 43.2 lattice at (43.2, 86.4 / 164.208 abutted), N edge; ONE std-cell band S (233 x 79 um) beside the S clock entry with the macro read face (W) on a 41-um leg, write face (E) on a 21-um leg; W/E pins over the full 265.7-um faces (E 1,089 = 4.2/um). Outline 216.0x200.88 -> 237.6x265.68 (slot request to Q-COMPUTE-DIE). | h13 (Q-IO-1815 TTH 2026-10-17): outline 259.2x259.2 -> 216.0x200.88 (-35%): the ref_tile rules keep >= 20 um between each SRAM and every core edge, so the minimum outline is the abutted pair (171.288 x 155.568, at_exact 22.464, 22.176 / 99.984) + 20-um channels; logic = one 20-um ring beside its pins; every W/E pin balanced over the full face (E 1,089 = 5.6/um at 1 track), ck_head/rst_n moved N -> S face (logic band), ck_pm at the SRAM clk y; pin regs; CMDREG=1. | h11 (Q-IO-1815 TTH 2026-10-16): h10 RTL (RSTREP) + f10 macro placement (both program SRAMs abutted at the S edge, x 43.2) + EVERY W/E data pin banded to y 60-255 (PPL ordered groups failed PPL-0086 in 19-um sections at 105-255 and 60-255; balanced placer, disjoint per-bus ranges proportional to width, 1-track minimum: E 1,089 pins need >=105 um at 1 track / 209 um at 2) beside the N logic band (E 1,089 M4 pins = 7.3/um, W 494 = 3.3/um); ck_head/rst_n stay N. f10 failed (-514) because its pins stayed at y 3-173 beside the SRAMs while the logic sat N; h10 (centred SRAMs) is a thin ring (-223). Pin registers per the owner rule (recipe-3 ot_pin_regs, clock ck_head): +1 edge on every port not already registered at its pin (per-port table ot_pin_regs.tsv; compiler schedule absorbs; die/ledger to be told). | h10 (Q-IO-1815 TTH 2026-10-16): h9b + RSTREP=1: the reset station flop drove 481 async clears (380 = rom_cmd_q, W face; gate high_fanout warn, recovery -154..-197 ps); three kept station copies of the identical function (rsl ~120 loads, rom_cmd_q halves 190 each), release unchanged, 0 edges (m0 REGROUP_PASS 65120 identical, OT_DPRE_MUT FAIL 19964). Control for the h10k two-root measurement. | h9 (Q-ELEM 1315): h8 gate worst moved to controller decode h_rd_c -> ir mux -> F(BASE)+dyn[F(D)] -> me_obase/xbase (-565.5). DPRE=1: the 10 base+DYN adds are computed per FIFO head word (hq, hq1) from flops and selected by h_rd copies after the add; exact, 0 edges. h8 (Q-ELEM 1315): h7 gate placement TT reg->reg -470.7 ps over 2,648 flops: u_issue.cycle -> 32-bit cycle==head compare (~410 ps OR tree) -> controller fan-out (~650 ps incl. cross-tile buffering) -> kvd fields / pin regs. Fix: SREG=1 (ot_qwen_fixed_issue): 'scheduled' is a register loaded with the exact next-state value; bit-identical every cycle (sim self-check + regroup bench vs ref), 0 edges. h3 (Q-COMPUTE-ELEM r14): h2 CTS refused by the strict multiple-CTS profile (ck_head drove 4,831 std FF + 2 raw SRAM clock pins: mixed source). The two program SRAMs now take explicit raw-macro clock entries ck_pm0/ck_pm1 (qfd_tt_ctlm_head_static_rk, derived by tools/qwen_split/derive_tt_head_rawck.py; shared source unchanged), W-face pins at the SRAM clk heights; std roots ck_head / ck_me_sched unchanged (clock hybrid_entries, flow 891a5f188). Parent delivers ck_pm0/1 from the same PLL phase as ck_head (same_pll_fixed_phase 0 ps). Logic, edges and outline unchanged. NEW head-side leaf of the selected static TT controller: exact original parent body minus the ROM tree (u_head + native route + resident relocation + loaded stage), formally equivalent regrouping (physical/qwen_tt_static_cluster_1015). Roots ck_head (4,813+route) / ck_me_sched (877), related phase-0; 2 SRAM 64x512; no ICG.
